description: This file is a PHP source file that handles the display and access control for the Settings module in a vtiger CRM project. It manages permissions, loads various setting options such as Layout Editor, Field Formulas, Tooltip management, and Workflow settings, and renders the corresponding template using Smarty.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class extended for vtiger CRM, used for rendering the settings pages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Smarty template object, initializes the Smarty environment.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template for rendering.
